name: MedBot Skywalker
description: The Skywalker Orthopedic Surgical Robot is a joint replacement robotic platform developed by MicroPort MedBot for total knee arthroplasty (TKA) and total hip arthroplasty (THA). The platform integrates a lightweight 6-axis collaborative robotic arm cart with an optical tracking system and CT-based 3D preoperative planning software. During surgery, the robotic arm positions osteotomy cutting guides or reaming tools to planned trajectories with real-time motion tracking compensation and safety boundary protection. The system has received NMPA approval in China, CE mark certification, and US FDA 510(k) clearance.
